mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_subtask (id, task_id, parent_id, agent_type, goal, inputs_json, dependency_json, status, execution_no, retry_count, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{taskId}, #{parentId}, #{agentType}, #{goal}, CAST(#{inputsJson} AS JSON), CAST(#{dependencyJson} AS JSON), #{status}, #{executionNo}, #{retryCount}, 1, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_subtask WHERE id = #{id} AND task_id = #{taskId}
SELECT * FROM ai_subtask WHERE id = #{id} AND task_id = #{taskId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM ai_subtask WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY created_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_subtask SET agent_type = #{agentType}, goal = #{goal}, inputs_json = CAST(#{inputsJson} AS JSON), status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND version = #{version}

UPDATE ai_subtask SET status = #{status}, execution_no = #{executionNo}, retry_count = #{retryCount}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, started_at = #{startedAt}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND version = #{version}

UPDATE ai_subtask SET status = 'RUNNING', execution_no = #{executionNo}, retry_count = #{retryCount}, error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL, started_at = #{startedAt}, finished_at = NULL, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'FAILED' AND version = #{version}
